description: Multimodal Simulator provides a discrete-event multimodal passenger-transport simulator with trip requests, vehicles and timing constraints. The provider is CIRRELT / lab-core. Geographical and temporal coverage: Users define origins, destinations, release times, ready times and due times; there is no fixed study geography. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is MIT. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The README describes passenger transport; the input's freight grouping should not determine the record's sector tags. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
